headline: Edenor Clarifies MetroGAS Purchase From YPF Has Not Yet Closed
summary: Argentine power distributor Edenor stated that its agreed transaction to buy gas distributor MetroGAS from state oil firm YPF has not yet closed, with MetroGAS remaining under current management.
why: MetroGAS is Argentina's largest natural gas distributor. Ownership transfers between major utility operators alter market concentration and corporate capital structures.

impacts.name: Edenor
impacts.why: Edenor clarified that its acquisition of MetroGAS from YPF remains incomplete.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Corporate clarification over the unfinalized MetroGAS takeover introduced short-term uncertainty for utility equities.
